Maya Patel: Heads-up 1: candidate Omar Khan can only interview after 5:30pm PT next Mon (5/18) due to timezone caregiving. Can we do a single 50min panel around 5:45pm PT?

Ethan Cole: I can shift my day and make 5:45pm PT work. Prefer remote.

Ravi Kapoor: Im available but have a 6:15pm call; 50m works if we start promptly.

Sofia Lee: I can cover the final 10 mins for culture/wrap.

Maya Patel: Plan: 5:456:35pm PT condensed loop. Ethan leads technical portion 5:45-6:20, Ravi deep dive 6:20-6:30, Sofia wrap 6:30-6:35.

Recruiter Bot: Policy note: childcare/caregiver support available for candidate interview travel or evening care up to $80 when pre-approved. Submit receipts to Expensify with code "CARE-INTERVIEW". Approval must be recorded before reimbursement.

Maya Patel: Pre-approving the stipend. Scheduling invite will include Zoom + backup Meet. Reserving Quiet Room B2 as backup if Omar prefers onsite last-minute.

Candidate - Omar: Confirms 5:45pm PT and appreciates the childcare support. Will join remote.

Ethan Cole: Can you add a short candidate prep note and a collaborative Google Doc for whiteboarding?

Maya Patel: Done. Calendar invite sent with Zoom + Meet, prep note, rubric, and expense instructions. Will DM Omar the stipend instructions and cc people-ops receipts inbox.

Ravi Kapoor: All set from my side.

Sofia Lee: Thanks Maya 1: that helped a lot!
